summary: Tested the Mayordomo/Grower feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. The check-in session keeps mayordomo and grower. Harvest create/update stores grower, and grower is kept on update when omitted. /api/receipts harvest_lines include grower. The harvests Excel has Mayordomo and Grower columns with values. The receipts Excel row 3 has Mayordomo and Grower with G3='Grower'. Frontend at 390px and 1920px: on /registrar, the Mayordomo and Grower rows sit under Tipo. Typing and blurring sends PUT /api/checkin-session with the merged session, and values stay after reload. Saving a scan (TEST_UI Juan, qty 2) stored mayordomo=TEST_Pedro and grower=TEST_GrowCo on the harvest. The /asistencia check-in view (opened with 'Check in') shows the same values inside the Rancho/Block card. Changing grower there synced back to /registrar. The Records print ticket fallback HTML contains 'Mayordomo: TEST_Pedro' and 'Grower: TEST_GrowCo'. Cleanup done: test worker and harvests deleted, original check-in session restored (it had no mayordomo/grower).

minor.issue: mayordomo/grower/block/variety use `data.x or existing.x`, so a user can never clear a field back to empty through an update.

integration_issues.issue: RecibosTab printReceipt/printBluetooth do not show Mayordomo or Grower. Only the Excel receipt export and the QuickHarvest worker ticket include them. If 'recibo' meant the printed receipt, this is missing.
The PUT payload sends mayordomo but not grower. The backend keeps the old value, so nothing breaks, but this is inconsistent.
lib/api.js sessionExportParams has no grower fallback param. The server reads the session first, so it works anyway.

issues: For about 1s before the session loads, the screen shows Precio $0.00, Tipo Pieza and empty Mayordomo/Grower. If the user types during this time, the session load can overwrite the input.
Mayordomo/Grower cells are narrow, so values get truncated (e.g. 'TEST_P...').
The 'CHECKED IN' counter label/number is partly covered by the keyboard/camera buttons (may have existed before).

action_items: Optional: add Mayordomo/Grower lines to RecibosTab printed receipts (HTML + Bluetooth) if the user expects them there
Add grower to the EditRecord PUT payload in QuickHarvest.jsx
Optional: give the Mayordomo/Grower cells more width in the 390px check-in card (or wrap text)
critical_code_review_comments: harvest update cannot clear text fields to empty (the `or existing` fallback)
QuickHarvest commitField sends the whole session object; a stale session in another tab could overwrite newer fields (last write wins)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MG Worker and TEST_UI Juan plus harvests during the run; all deleted. Check-in session restored to the original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, then pytest tests/test_mayordomo_grower.py. The test saves and restores the check-in session. The ticket HTML can be captured by overriding URL.createObjectURL plus window.open in page.evaluate.
